capability/fix 2026-10-11 (session 18): adjust_volume, play_media and read_notifications were each registered, validated, parsed, fast-pathed, prompt-advertised AND given a real executor branch - yet a step using them could never COMPLETE. Root cause: their default verification is NONE, and TaskOrchestrator.verifyAction had a self-evidencing carve-out only for ReadText/ReadPageContent (the 9.4 fix), so a NONE-verified adjust_volume/play_media/read_notifications step was retried until maxRetries and failed - and the goal gate (selfEvidencingToolSatisfied) had no branch for them either. They were 'written but not working' in the same class the 9.4 read defect belonged to. verifyAction now accepts a successful result for these three as the step evidence, and selfEvidencingToolSatisfied counts a completed one as goal evidence.

safety 2026-10-11 (session 18): the self-evidencing carve-out only accepts a genuinely successful ActionResult (the `!result.success` guard runs first), so it is safe only because the executor reports success honestly - AndroidAudioController/AndroidMediaController read the stream level / isMusicActive() back and return AUDIO_UNCHANGED/MEDIA_UNCHANGED when nothing moved. It must never be widened to an action whose success is not independently read back. Recorded in AGENTS.md.

9.9 capability-loss fix 2026-10-11 (session 18): read_notifications could never complete in the live loop. AndroidDeviceAutomation.readNotificationDigest() returned success=true with method=READ_NOTIFICATIONS but NO readText, and TaskOrchestrator.verifyAction self-satisfied only ReadText/ReadPageContent for a NONE verification, so the step's default NONE postcondition could never be satisfied: it retried to exhaustion and every triage read failed. The goal gate's selfEvidencingToolSatisfied(ReadNotifications) allowance was therefore unreachable dead code. Fix: (1) readNotificationDigest carries the digest as ActionResult.readText (capped at MAX_CAPTURED_CHARS, null when blank); (2) verifyAction treats a NONE-verified ReadNotifications as satisfied by that non-empty digest (empty -> failure, never a fake success), with an honest 'Read N chars of notification digest' detail.

regression tests 2026-10-11 (session 18): CapabilityUpgradeTest.readNotificationsStepCompletesFromItsOwnDigestWithoutAScreenChange (orchestrator completes a read_notifications step with NONE verification) and Phase4UpgradeTest.readNotificationsReadsDigestWhenTriageOn now asserts the digest is carried as readText. Fails-before evidence: with DeviceAutomation.kt+TaskOrchestrator.kt stashed, the new test FAILED (AssertionError CapabilityUpgradeTest.kt:636); with the fix restored it passes.
